fields.label: Account
fields.description: P&L / base account whose Journal-Entry postings feed a declaration grid (e.g. a revenue account for periodic takings). Do not map VAT accounts here — VAT is read from the accounts above.

fields.label: Grid
fields.description: Declaration grid the account's Journal-Entry base flows into (e.g. 03 for services taxed at 21%).

fields.label: Sign
fields.description: Contribution = (credit − debit) × sign. Leave +1 for income accounts (credit balance); use -1 for expense accounts so the base comes out positive.
